records.name: JJ School of Art Mumbai
records.description: Sir J.J. School of Art Mumbai, established in 1857, is one of India's oldest and most prestigious fine arts institutions, affiliated with the University of Mumbai. It offers programs in painting, sculpture, applied arts, and art history, and has nurtured generations of India's most celebrated artists, designers, and art educators. The school is a landmark of Mumbai's cultural heritage and continues to be a leading center for fine arts education in India.

records.name: College of Architecture Trivandrum
records.description: College of Architecture Trivandrum (CAT), established in 1971, is Kerala's premier government architecture college offering BArch and MArch programs under the University of Kerala. It is known for its focus on tropical architecture, sustainable design, and the rich architectural traditions of Kerala. The college is accredited by the Council of Architecture and produces graduates who contribute significantly to Kerala's distinctive built environment.

records.name: Chandigarh College of Architecture
records.description: Chandigarh College of Architecture (CCA), established in 1961 alongside Le Corbusier's planned city, is a prestigious architecture institution offering BArch and MArch programs. The college's unique setting in a UNESCO World Heritage-listed city provides students with exceptional exposure to modernist urban planning and architectural design. CCA is affiliated with Panjab University and is known for its strong design culture and accomplished alumni.

records.name: KEM Hospital Mumbai
records.description: King Edward Memorial (KEM) Hospital Mumbai, established in 1926, is one of India's most prestigious public teaching hospitals, affiliated with the Seth GS Medical College. It is a premier center for medical education and training, offering MBBS, MD, MS, and super-specialty programs and providing tertiary care to millions of patients annually. KEM is recognized for breakthrough medical research and training generations of India's leading doctors and specialists.

records.name: Rajiv Gandhi Academy for Aviation Technology
records.description: Rajiv Gandhi Academy for Aviation Technology (RGAAT) Thiruvananthapuram is a training institution under the Government of Kerala offering aviation-related programs including aircraft maintenance engineering and aviation management. It provides training aligned with DGCA requirements for aviation professionals and aims to meet the growing demand for skilled aviation workforce in India. RGAAT benefits from its location near Trivandrum International Airport, providing students with practical aviation exposure.

records.name: Indira Gandhi Institute of Aeronautics
records.description: Indira Gandhi Institute of Aeronautics (IGIA) Chandigarh offers aviation training programs including commercial pilot license training, aircraft maintenance engineering, and airport management courses. The institute is approved by the DGCA (Directorate General of Civil Aviation) and provides comprehensive ground and flying training for aspiring aviation professionals. IGIA is recognized as one of North India's established aviation training institutes with modern training facilities.

records.name: Aldine CA Classes
records.description: Aldine CA Classes Mumbai is a well-known coaching institute specializing in preparation for CA (Chartered Accountancy) examinations conducted by ICAI. It is recognized for its experienced faculty, structured study material, and high success rates in CA Foundation, Intermediate, and Final examinations. Aldine has helped thousands of CA aspirants in Mumbai navigate the rigorous ICAI examination process over several decades.

records.name: LV Prasad Film and TV Academy
records.description: LV Prasad Film and TV Academy Chennai offers programs in filmmaking, direction, cinematography, and editing, providing practical training for aspiring film and television professionals in South India. The academy is associated with the legacy of the legendary filmmaker L.V. Prasad and is recognized for producing talented professionals in Tamil and other regional film industries. It focuses on hands-on training with professional-grade equipment and industry mentorship.

records.name: Shankar IAS Academy
records.description: Shankar IAS Academy Chennai is one of India's most successful civil services coaching institutes, renowned for producing top-ranked IAS, IPS, and IFoS officers consistently. The academy offers classroom and online coaching for UPSC Civil Services, Tamil Nadu Public Service Commission, and other state PSC examinations. Shankar IAS is particularly well-regarded for its General Studies and optional subject coaching, with a track record of hundreds of selections each year.

records.name: Indian Military Academy (IMA) Dehradun
records.description: Indian Military Academy (IMA) Dehradun, established in 1932, is the premier training academy for officers of the Indian Army, modeled on the Royal Military Academy Sandhurst. It trains gentleman cadets selected through UPSC examinations and the Short Service Commission process, producing commissioned officers of the Indian Army. IMA is renowned for its rigorous physical, academic, and leadership training that shapes India's future army officers.
